opening.text: I've come in because I have a cough and some pain. My nose is stuffy or running clear, and I've got greenish or yellowish discharge from it. I should mention I smoke cigarettes, and I've been diagnosed with gastroesophageal reflux in the past. I've also had pneumonia before.
